# Controle de Qualidade da Expressão (GSE116250)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

## 1. Leitura dos dados

```{r load}
rpkm <- read.delim(gzfile("data/raw/GSE116250_rpkm.txt.gz"),
                   check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Matriz numérica: primeira coluna = Gene, segunda = Common_name
expr <- rpkm[, -(1:2)]
expr <- as.data.frame(lapply(expr, as.numeric))
rownames(expr) <- make.unique(rpkm$Common_name)

# Metadados
pheno <- read.csv("output/tables/ampk/metadados_das_amostras.csv", check.names = FALSE)
pheno <- pheno |>
  dplyr::select(title, `disease:ch1`, `Sex:ch1`, `age:ch1`) |>
  dplyr::rename(sample = title, group = `disease:ch1`, sex = `Sex:ch1`, age = `age:ch1`)
```

## 2. Violino antes da normalização (escala linear RPKM)

```{r violin-before, fig.height=7}
expr_long <- expr |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expr") |>
  dplyr::left_join(pheno, by = "sample")

ggplot(expr_long, aes(x = sample, y = expr + 1, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.15,
               fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, color = "grey30") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "Distribuição de expressão por amostra (RPKM, antes da normalização)",
       y = "RPKM + 1 (log10)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 3. Violino depois da normalização (log2(CPM/TMM), sugerida)

```{r violin-after, fig.height=7}
# Transformação reprodutível sugerida (config.yaml: normalization = log2-TMM)
expr_log <- log2(expr + 1)
expr_log_long <- expr_log |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expr") |>
  dplyr::left_join(pheno, by = "sample")

ggplot(expr_log_long, aes(x = sample, y = expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, linewidth = 0.15, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.15,
               fill = "white", alpha = 0.85, color = "grey30") +
  labs(title = "Distribuição de expressão por amostra (log2(RPKM + 1))",
       y = "log2(RPKM + 1)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 4. PCA (detecção de batch effect)

```{r pca, fig.height=6}
# Remove genes com variância zero e centraliza
expr_t <- t(expr_log)
expr_t <- expr_t[, apply(expr_t, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]
pca <- prcomp(expr_t, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- data.frame(sample = rownames(expr_t), PC1 = pca$x[, 1], PC2 = pca$x[, 2]) |>
  dplyr::left_join(pheno, by = "sample")

ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = group, shape = sex)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  labs(title = "PCA das amostras GSE116250",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100 * summary(pca)$importance[2, 2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## 5. Percentual de genes detectados por amostra

```{r detected}
detected <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(expr),
  pct_detected = 100 * colMeans(expr > 0)
) |>
  dplyr::left_join(pheno, by = "sample")

ggplot(detected, aes(x = sample, y = pct_detected, fill = group)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Percentual de genes detectados por amostra",
       y = "% genes com RPKM > 0") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```
